trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(pd:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(td:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(cd:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t), (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(od:Document) WHERE (c.city_name = 'Brooklyn' AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0) OR (t.team_name <> 'Detroit Pistons' AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <> 41) RETURN o.nationality AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2
